picked_rationale.C1: C1 is the foundational existence claim — it tests whether a linear probe on per-agent residual-stream activations can recover a collusion signal that a text-only judge misses. C2 (aggregation) depends entirely on M1's per-agent probe scores, and C3 (transfer) applies the frozen M1 probe zero-shot; if C1 does not hold cross-model, neither C2 nor C3 has a stable foundation. The C1 result is also the most uncertain (partial verdict: probe_AUROC=0.665 just below the 0.75 threshold), making it the highest-value claim to stress-test: a model-swap pass confirms the collusion signal exists beyond the specific Qwen3-32B-AWQ quantization, while a fail would indicate model specificity.
